plain_language_idea: Test whether persistent order-book imbalance predicts short-horizon BTCUSDT continuation.

market_hypothesis.claim: Persistent bid-ask depth imbalance predicts short-horizon continuation.
market_hypothesis.causal_rationale: Queued liquidity asymmetry can reveal near-term supply-demand pressure.
market_hypothesis.observable_prediction: Completed snapshots with persistent imbalance precede directionally aligned returns.

required_indicators_features.description: Causal depth imbalance from timestamped snapshots.

entry_exit_concept.entry: Enter at next bar open after completed-snapshot imbalance persists for the configured observation window.
entry_exit_concept.exit: Exit after the bounded holding period or on an opposite completed-snapshot signal.

risk_logic_concept.exit_risk_logic: Bound the research holding period and report gap sensitivity.

expected_edge_mechanism: Persistent queued-liquidity asymmetry precedes short-horizon price adjustment.
failure_modes: Displayed depth may cancel before execution.
Snapshot gaps may bias persistence estimates.
overfit_risks: Threshold selection may fit transient microstructure regimes.
validation_requirements: Acquire timestamped order-book snapshots with gap provenance before testing.
stop_conditions: Stop if snapshot coverage cannot support causal alignment.

upgrade_dependencies.description: Timestamped order-book snapshot dataset with provenance and gap policy.
